text:
carla: Observed 502 spikes during eu-west canary while a node-drain coincided with PV attach delays. deploy-bot tripped automated rollback hold (max-evict-time exceeded).
deploy-bot: Automated alert: promotion stalled. Action: will rollback in 5m unless manual pin annotated. Reason: 502s during pod eviction. :exclamation:
carla: Looks like the new ASG scale-out and kubelet PV attach queue overlapped with our drain. Pods Pending for >30s waiting for attach. Not seeing code errors.
sre-oncall: If PV attach is root cause we can extend the eviction/termination grace but that requires a manual pin to suppress auto-rollback. Error rate peaked at ~7% but limited to eu-west canary shard.
alice: Can we route a fraction of traffic back to stable while keeping canary pods running? That would avoid total rollback and preserve metrics.
ben: Fallback route is doable, but deploy-bot will still execute rollback unless pinned. Quick path: annotate HelmRelease to pin, then patch deployctl to pause automated rollback.
carla: Plan: 1) Apply pin annotation on srvc-api-v3 helmrelease 2) Patch rollout to pause automated rollback 3) Create infra ticket to re-run PV attach 4) Re-evaluate in 30m, rollback if errors persist.
alice: Agreed. How to run the pin command quickly?
ben: I ran this earlier: `kubectl annotate helmrelease srvc-api-v3 release.redwood/pinned-by="carla" release.redwood/pin-reason="pv-attach-evac" --overwrite` then `deployctl rollout patch srvc-api-v3 --suppress-auto-rollback=true`
deploy-bot: Note: Presence of release.redwood/pinned-by annotation suppresses automated rollback for TTL 60m. Please include authorizing reviewer in annotation.
sre-oncall: Authorizing pin: sre-oncall. I'll monitor error budget and remove pin if we see regressions.
carla: Done. Annotated helmrelease and patched rollout. Added release-note snippet: "Temporary pin for srvc-api-v3 in eu-west due to PV attach delays during node drain. Monitoring infra recovery. Rollback if unresolved after 30m."
alice: I'll update the changelog and ping #product-notifications with a short line.
ben: Added changelog note: "Pinned deployment during node-drain to avoid unnecessary rollback; follow-up INFRA ticket created."
sre-oncall: Created INFRA ticket: INFRA-2147 (retrigger PV attach + requeue node-drain). I'll watch metrics; current error rate trending down after node rebalancing.
carla: If metrics are green at +25m I'll remove pin and allow promotion to continue. If not, we trigger rollback at +30m as discussed.
deploy-bot: Automated rollback suppressed until 1767023599 (60m TTL). Manual unpin command: `kubectl annotate helmrelease srvc-api-v3 release.redwood/pinned-by-`
carla: Copy. Monitoring in place. Closing this thread unless status changes. :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: Noted. Will open short incident note if rollback occurs.
carla: Thanks everyone. Will post update when pin removed or rollback executed.
